with __dbt__cte__int_support__ticket_metrics as (


select
    tickets.ticket_id,
    tickets.customer_id,
    tickets.order_id,
    tickets.opened_at,
    tickets.solved_at,
    tickets.contact_channel,
    tickets.category,
    tickets.priority,
    date_diff('minute', tickets.opened_at, tickets.solved_at) / 60.0 as resolution_hours,
    csat.csat_score,
    csat.is_satisfied
from "larkspur"."staging"."stg_support__tickets" as tickets
left join "larkspur"."staging"."stg_support__csat" as csat using (ticket_id)
) select
    ticket_id,
    customer_id,
    order_id,
    opened_at,
    solved_at,
    contact_channel,
    category,
    priority,
    resolution_hours,
    resolution_hours <= 24 as solved_within_sla,
    csat_score,
    is_satisfied
from __dbt__cte__int_support__ticket_metrics

select
    charges.order_id,
    count(*) as charge_attempts,
    count(*) filter (where charges.is_successful) as successful_charges,
    sum(case when charges.is_successful then charges.amount else 0 end) as amount_captured,
    sum(charges.processing_fee) as processing_fees,
    coalesce(sum(refunds.amount), 0) as amount_refunded_by_processor,
    max(charges.payment_method) as payment_method
from "larkspur"."staging"."stg_payments__charges" as charges
left join "larkspur"."staging"."stg_payments__refunds" as refunds using (charge_id)
group by 1

-- Line-level revenue, cost and margin for storefront orders.
select
    lines.order_line_id,
    lines.order_id,
    lines.variant_id,
    variants.product_id,
    products.category,
    lines.quantity,
    lines.gross_amount,
    lines.discount_amount,
    lines.gross_amount - lines.discount_amount as net_amount,
    products.unit_cost * lines.quantity as cost_amount,
    lines.gross_amount - lines.discount_amount - products.unit_cost * lines.quantity as margin_amount
from "larkspur"."staging"."stg_shop__order_lines" as lines
left join "larkspur"."staging"."stg_shop__variants" as variants using (variant_id)
left join "larkspur"."staging"."stg_shop__products" as products using (product_id)

    from "larkspur"."intermediate"."int_inventory__monthly_position"
    group by 1, 2
),

demand as (
    select date_trunc('month', sold_at) as month, products.category, sum(sales.quantity) as units_sold
    from "larkspur"."intermediate"."int_sales__unified" as sales
    left join "larkspur"."staging"."stg_shop__variants" as variants using (variant_id)
    left join "larkspur"."marts"."dim_products" as products using (product_id)
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    position.snapshot_date,
    position.category,
    position.units_available,
    position.stock_value,
    position.stocked_out_variants,
    round(position.stocked_out_variants / position.tracked_variants, 3) as stockout_rate,
    demand.units_sold,
    round(position.units_available / nullif(demand.units_sold, 0), 1) as months_of_cover
from position
left join demand
    on position.snapshot_date = cast(demand.month as date)
    and position.category = demand.category

    case

with spend as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', spend_date) as month,
        channel_group,
        sum(spend) as spend
    from "larkspur"."marts"."fct_marketing_spend"
    group by 1, 2
),

attributed as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', orders.ordered_at) as month,
        attributed.channel_group,
        count(*) as attributed_orders,
        sum(attributed.attributed_revenue) as attributed_revenue,
        sum(attributed.attributed_margin) as attributed_margin
    from "larkspur"."intermediate"."int_marketing__attributed_orders" as attributed
    inner join "larkspur"."marts"."fct_orders" as orders using (order_id)
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    cast(coalesce(attributed.month, spend.month) as date) as month,
    coalesce(attributed.channel_group, spend.channel_group) as channel_group,
    coalesce(spend.spend, 0) as spend,
    coalesce(attributed.attributed_orders, 0) as attributed_orders,
    coalesce(attributed.attributed_revenue, 0) as attributed_revenue,
    round(attributed.attributed_revenue / nullif(spend.spend, 0), 2) as return_on_ad_spend,
    round(spend.spend / nullif(attributed.attributed_orders, 0), 2) as cost_per_order
from attributed
full outer join spend
    on attributed.month = spend.month
    and attributed.channel_group = spend.channel_group

with revenue as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', revenue_date) as month,
        sum(revenue) as revenue,
        sum(margin) as margin,
        sum(case when sales_source = 'store' then revenue else 0 end) as store_revenue
    from "larkspur"."marts"."fct_daily_revenue"
    group by 1
),

orders as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', ordered_at) as month,
        count(*) as orders,
        avg(order_total) as average_order_value,
        sum(refund_amount) as refunds
    from "larkspur"."marts"."fct_orders"
    group by 1
),

new_customers as (
    select date_trunc('month', first_ordered_at) as month, count(*) as new_customers
    from "larkspur"."marts"."dim_customers"
    where first_ordered_at is not null
    group by 1
),

club as (
    select date_trunc('month', month) as month, sum(mrr) as club_mrr
    from "larkspur"."marts"."fct_club_mrr"
    group by 1
),

support as (
    select date_trunc('month', opened_at) as month, avg(csat_score) as average_csat
    from "larkspur"."marts"."fct_support_tickets"
    group by 1
)

select
    cast(revenue.month as date) as month,
    revenue.revenue,
    revenue.margin,
    round(revenue.margin / nullif(revenue.revenue, 0), 3) as margin_rate,
    revenue.store_revenue,
    orders.orders,
    orders.average_order_value,
    orders.refunds,
    new_customers.new_customers,
    club.club_mrr,
    support.average_csat
from revenue
left join orders using (month)
left join new_customers using (month)
left join club using (month)
left join support using (month)

select
    customers.customer_id,
    customers.region,
    customers.lifecycle_stage,
    customers.is_club_member,
    cast(date_trunc('month', customers.first_ordered_at) as date) as cohort_month,
    customers.order_count,
    customers.lifetime_net_revenue,
    customers.lifetime_net_revenue / nullif(customers.order_count, 0) as average_order_value,
    date_diff('day', customers.first_ordered_at, customers.last_ordered_at) as active_days,
    first_touch.channel_group as acquisition_channel
from "larkspur"."marts"."dim_customers" as customers
left join (
    select orders.customer_id, attributed.channel_group,
        row_number() over (partition by orders.customer_id order by orders.ordered_at) as touch
    from "larkspur"."intermediate"."int_marketing__attributed_orders" as attributed
    inner join "larkspur"."marts"."fct_orders" as orders using (order_id)
) as first_touch
    on customers.customer_id = first_touch.customer_id
    and first_touch.touch = 1
where customers.order_count > 0
